basics.name: Kauntey Acharya
basics.label: AI Automation Engineer | AI Strategist & Consultant | Quantitative Analyst
basics.positioning: Designing AI-powered workflows, agents, and automation systems that turn repetitive processes into reliable, scalable solutions.
basics.summary: I am an AI Automation Engineer and Analyst at Innodata Inc., and I also work as an AI strategist and consultant. I help identify where AI can create practical leverage, translate business problems into AI solutions, and build working prototypes for real workflows: agentic workflows, RAG systems, research agents, API automations, and human-in-the-loop systems using n8n, Python, LLMs, and local AI. Evaluation is a big part of my work. I test LLM behaviour, retrieval quality, workflow reliability, and automation performance to understand where and why AI systems succeed or fail. I bring the same quantitative toolkit (statistics, time-series modelling, and Bayesian inference) to quantitative analysis and finance. Before industry, I was a pre-doctoral research fellow in theoretical physics at Ahmedabad University. My research focused on compact objects in general relativity, including naked singularities, black-hole mimickers, energy extraction, and high-energy particle collisions, and led to four peer-reviewed papers in journals such as Physical Review D and the European Physical Journal C.

projects.name: AI Stack Advisor: Build-vs-Buy Calculator for AI
projects.description: Describe what you want AI to do, and it compares five ways to get there (buy a SaaS tool, build on hosted LLM APIs, run an open model on your own GPUs, mix the two, or pay per token for a hosted open model) on monthly cost, 36-month total cost of ownership, break-even volume, and ROI. Every assumption is shown, and 300 simulations report how often each option wins. It runs entirely in the browser.

projects.name: TickerBrief: Automated Equity Research Reports
projects.description: Type a ticker and get a full equity research report as an interactive web page and a PDF. An n8n workflow pulls prices, fundamentals, peers, SEC filings, and news in parallel; Python computes ratios, technical indicators, and sentiment; and a local LLM writes the narrative in three structured passes, with rule-based fallbacks.

projects.name: Model Monitoring + Drift Alert Agent
projects.description: A local MLOps stack that watches a deployed model. An n8n workflow scores new traffic, logs predictions to Postgres, and measures data, prediction, and target drift with Evidently AI. When a threshold is crossed, a local LLM explains the likely root cause in plain English and posts it to Slack, with a Grafana dashboard for the history.

projects.name: ArXiv Research Analysis Agent
projects.description: Monitors arXiv every morning (gr-qc and q-fin by default), filters new papers by keyword, and sends a Telegram brief with a yes/no prompt. On “yes” it downloads the PDF, has a local LLM walk through the paper from first principles, and returns a Markdown report.

projects.name: Local RAG Document Q&A Agent
projects.description: A fully local retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. Upload a PDF, TXT, DOCX, or MD file; it is chunked, embedded with nomic-embed-text, and stored in ChromaDB, and questions are answered by llama3.2 under a strict answer-only-from-context prompt. No cloud APIs, and no data leaves the machine.
